exposure: human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) in maternal milk
cohort: Healthy, breastfed, 1-month-old infants from the KOALA Birth Cohort
finding: Maternal milk HMO composition is associated with infant fecal microbiota composition at 1 month of age, and the ability of an infant's gut microbiota to degrade specific HMOs is linked to the abundance of certain bacterial phylotypes.
mod_finding: Infant fecal microbiota composition was associated with delivery mode.
